change.what: Sinkhorn balancing weight: infer.py line ~1418 sets final log-score = (1 - s)*log P + s*log Q, where Q is P Sinkhorn-balanced toward a class marginal (35% official-train prior); s is the weight on the balanced posterior
change.why: infer.py exposes no logit-temperature argument, so the closest existing probability-calibration knob is used: s geometrically interpolates the raw and class-balanced posteriors. 0.30 -> 0.25 (-1/6) relaxes the assumption that hidden-test classes are balanced; it touches nothing else.
